title: Gen-CQ
fill_note: DENSE layered wind with a jig; scorer cap 0.65
fill_how: The scored turns assume a dense, layer-by-layer wind at fill 0.65 (insulated-wire area / window; the scorer cap). Use a winding jig on a drill/lathe with a turn counter, lay each layer side-by-side with light back-tension, and do not scramble-wind: a scramble wind only reaches ≈0.55–0.60 and then the window holds fewer turns (scorer what-if `--fill 0.60` is in the table above). Never wind more than the listed turns — the copper must stay below the flanges.
steel_extra: **New steel:** Ø202 discs, M3 clamp map R30 at 0/90/180/270° and R44 on the inter-pole angles 67.5/112.5/247.5/292.5° (both inside the R88 magnet ring). Cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf`; no earlier disc fits.
o5_note: 48 DIAMETRIC Ø5×5 fitted, 3 per inter-pole gap (R80.6/86.8/93), Halbach-oriented (rule engraved on every arc)
card_title: Gen-CQ · 8p/12c · T-pole WIRE-SAVER (Gen-CP rotors, thin-copper stator, ≈325 m)
card_sub: exactly the Gen-CP rotors + Ø202 steel · stator bobbins r60–105.5 × 4.2 mm, shorter gap sleeve · leaves ≈65 m of the spool · 2026-10-19
idea: Modular swap on the Gen-CP rotors: the same 16 T-pole arcs, magnets and Ø202 steel discs, on a thinner-copper stator (4.2 mm copper, so the magnet faces close in by 0.45 mm) wound with only ≈325 m of 26 AWG — about 65 m of the spool stays free for leads/repairs. Swapping between Gen-CP and Gen-CQ is a stator + gap-sleeve change only.
retro_md:
## Modular notes (Gen-CQ = stator swap for Gen-CP)

Rotors, arcs, magnets, Ø202 steel, hubs, frame, bearing bridges, standoffs, shaft and collars are **identical to Gen-CP** (same files). Only the stator, 12 bobbins + lids, gap sleeve and shims differ. To swap: thread the 4 temporary M4 jack rods, raise rotor B on the nuts (never by hand), swap stator + gap sleeve, lower rotor B, remove the rods. The frame standoffs are the same length (they do not depend on the copper height); the gap sleeve is 0.9 mm shorter.
steel_note: Steel: 2× Ø202 × 4.76 mm (3/16") mild-steel discs, clamp map hub M3 at R22 0/90/180/270°, 4× Ø4.3 brace holes R18 at 45/135/225/315°, 16 arc-clamp M3 at R88 ±13° from every pole, index notch at +X — cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf` (laser-cut service). Lobed arcs: 2.4 mm PLA around each pocket; the epoxy-to-steel bond, not the PLA, holds the magnets. **Identical to Gen-CP's discs — same rotors.**
